name: antevemus/alinq-collection
description: Enterprise LINQ-Style Collection Framework for PHP 8.4+ (Fluent API, Native Array Primitives, Query Builder, Set Operations, Dot-Notation Property Access)

authors.name: Heliton Junior - CTO @ Antevemus Soluções Inovadoras em TI Ltda.

suggest.ext-intl: Required by StringComparer::culture() (since 2.2.0): text compared by the collation rules of a language (ICU), ignoring case and/or accents, numeric ordering; without it culture() throws LogicException and ordinal()/ordinalIgnoreCase() keep working
suggest.ext-mbstring: Required by StringComparer::ordinalIgnoreCase() (since 2.2.0): Unicode case folding; without it ordinalIgnoreCase() throws LogicException
suggest.ext-curl: Required by ALinqLazyCollection::fromHttpPages() (since 1.5.0) and fromHttpPagesByIndex() (since 2.4.0): lazy sources over a paginated HTTP API that prefetch the next pages with curl_multi
suggest.antevemus/alinq-revolt: ^1.0 — ALinqAsyncCollection: selectAsync()/whereAsync()/selectManyAsync()/eachAsync() over the Revolt event loop (Fibers, Amp futures) with an ordered, bounded window of items in flight, for I/O per item against asynchronous SDKs
suggest.antevemus/alinq-parallel: ^1.0 — ALinqParallelCollection: selectParallel()/whereParallel()/selectManyParallel()/eachParallel() over a pool of PHP worker processes, for CPU-bound work per item (a Fiber alone is not parallelism); the work must be transportable to another process (a static method or a serializable invokable, never a closure)
suggest.antevemus/aspecification: ^2.0.0 — Specification pattern with ALinqBridge and ALinqSpecificationVisitor: evaluate domain specifications over eager and lazy ALinq collections (docs/en/concepts/aspecification-synergy.md); since 2.0 both packages resolve property names through the same antevemus/adeep-property-access
